notes.title: Update note - 11.05.15
notes.notes:
Dear CroNix players, 
There will be an update from 22:00, 23:00, 5th Nov., Pacific time. 
Please make sure to quit the game before the update! 

This update will implement following features;


■ System
Players are required to reach lv.15 before entering Raid mode.

■ Character
Kiriha is now available.

■ Skill
[Common]
- Combos are now easier to perform. 
- Executing a same skill consecutively will shorten the skill’s cooltime. 
- Limited character & camera movement are possible even when executing a skill.

[Heabig]
Punish - Hitbox has been moved forward.

[Charles] 
Skull warhead - now deals more damage, but more AP s required.

[Zic]
Double Rake  - now needs 5 AP(Previously it was 0).

[Chris]
Knee Kick - now needs 30 AP(previously it was 35).
Elbow Strike - now has much bigger hitbox, but deals slightly less damage.
Speedster - now needs 40 AP(previously it was 50), and a new UI displays the duration time.
Lunge Upper - now needs 5 AP only(previously it was 10).

■ Store
[Characters]
Kiriha is available. She costs 15000 Seeds.
All characters are now purchasable with CroNix Cash. When purchased with Cash, they are not level-restricted.

[Tonics]
New Tonic Packs are available. These are sold in Cash, and has Grade 2~4 Tonics that last 3 or 7 days.

■ UI
Game Start and Player Information interface has been changed.

■ ETC.
Until a player reaches lv.4, a 'recommended' icon will appear on Elimination mode.

Thank you!

notes.title: Future update plans
notes.notes:
Dear CroNix players,
I'd like to inform you about some incoming contents. These contents are planned to arrive in this month.

[h1]1. New mode and map![/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2T1k6Gi.jpg[/img]
A new PvP mode called X-Elimination is coming soon. It's similar to Elimination - Acquire more kills to win!
Of course, there are differences.
[list]
[*]In each team, a random character becomes an 'X'. X-character is more powerful and durable than others.
[*]When an X-character dies, another teammate becomes one.
[*]There's no extra score for killing an X-character. 
[*]From time to time, Ronic, the robot guy from tutorial, will appear in the center of the map. Interact with him to get super-effective buff!
[/list]

[h1]2. Kiriha is back![/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/46yNDQL.jpg[/img]
Yes, the kunoichi girl is back! Previously she was in Beta version of the game, but she could not make it to the current version due to balancing issues.
While her ninja look might trick you to believe that she's an assassin like Liulian, she's actually a Supporter.
She can't deal much damage, and she's not durable either. This might make her look like a weak character, and it is partly true when she acts ALONE. 
She is, however, an exceptionally outstanding supporter when she helps her teammates. 
[list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/m8rdL5v.png[/img]
[*]Flying Leaf : This is her normal attack. It's not a powerful attack, but it's effective for bothering enemies to cut off their attack.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hFzAili.png[/img]
[*]Grapplig Hook : Her signiture skill! You can snatch an enemy from afar and bring the poor target right before your feet. You can even snatch a fallen enemy, which will give your teammates more precious seconds to attack the target.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wbMU80s.png[/img]
[*]Bee Sting : A short-ranged dash attack that knocks down the target. The damage is not significant, but you'll earn some precious seconds to run away from the target.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wZV8klI.png[/img]
[*]Flower Bomb : This is an invisible proximity mine that detonates when an enemy is in vicinity. Remember to place these around your feet at all time! Yes, it can be used for offense, by using in conjunction with Grappling Hook for more damage, but it serves better as a defensive device. Simply, enemies will not dare to approach Kiriha even when they see her alone, off-guard. It's a real headache for Liulian as well.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/YsgrvwR.png[/img]
[*]Shadow Copy & Teleport : A crucial skill for survival. Always leave a shadow copy somewhere around to use as an escape measure.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qLKx0i2.png[/img]
[*]Exploding Blossom : This is Kiriha's Special Skill, and in fact, the only skill that can deal significant damage alone. The exploding kunais can be spread widely for carpet bombing, or can be concentrated for higher damage against fewer targets.
[/list]

You might have noticed this - If there's Kiriha in your team, it's important to USE her. 
She's especially effective when acting with Assualters such as Gordon; she can use Grappling Hook to 'deliver' an enemy to Gordon like pizza for easy kill.     

I'll keep you informed!

notes.title: Incoming update – Property
notes.notes:
Property is a new feature in CroNix that gives you a little more edge in the battle. 
You can access Property menu in Character category. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UgJBZxF.png[/img]
There are 14 tiers of Properties – Defense, Tonic(1, 2), Attack, Sprint, Mobility, Defensive action, Offensive action, Accuracy, Shift skill(1, 2, 3, 4) and Optional. There are 3 Properties in each tier, but you can only select one Property in one tier. Some tiers are locked at first, and require your character to reach certain level to unlock.

Each Property will enhance your performance by granting your character special attributes. These attributes include increased maximum HP, faster Tonic use, increased damage and so on. The most notable attributes are Shift skills, which enhances ordinary skills when used while holding down Shift.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BkRuuGI.jpg[/img]

You can equip up to 9 Properties. Equipping a Property costs 500 Seeds at first, and the cost will increase afterwards. Equipping all 9 Properties will cost considerable amount of Seeds. 
You can remove an equipped Property by double-clicking the undesired Property. In this way, however, you won’t be receiving any refund. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GzaUWyC.jpg[/img]

But you can always choose to spend 30 Premium Kits to reset all your Properties and get all the Seeds you spent on them. This will save you great amount of Seeds, but it’s completely optional. 

Note that these screenshots were taken in mid-development stage. Final version may differ.

notes.title: Incoming update – Property
notes.notes:
Property is a new feature in CroNix that gives you a little more edge in the battle. 
You can access Property menu in Character category. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UgJBZxF.png[/img]
There are 14 tiers of Properties – Defense, Tonic(1, 2), Attack, Sprint, Mobility, Defensive action, Offensive action, Accuracy, Shift skill(1, 2, 3, 4) and Optional. There are 3 Properties in each tier, but you can only select one Property in one tier. Some tiers are locked at first, and require your character to reach certain level to unlock.

Each Property will enhance your performance by granting your character special attributes. These attributes include increased maximum HP, faster Tonic use, increased damage and so on. The most notable attributes are Shift skills, which enhances ordinary skills when used while holding down Shift.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BkRuuGI.jpg[/img]

You can equip up to 9 Properties. Equipping a Property costs 500 Seeds at first, and the cost will increase afterwards. Equipping all 9 Properties will cost considerable amount of Seeds. 
You can remove an equipped Property by double-clicking the undesired Property. In this way, however, you won’t be receiving any refund. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GzaUWyC.jpg[/img]

But you can always choose to spend 30 Premium Kits to reset all your Properties and get all the Seeds you spent on them. This will save you great amount of Seeds, but it’s completely optional. 

Note that these screenshots were taken in mid-development stage. Final version may differ.

Property is planned to be implemented on next update(7.30.15.) The update will begin at 23:00 and end at 00:00, PBT. Please make sure to quit the game before the update!

notes.title: The BIG Patch announcement - 06.18.15
notes.notes:
Dear CroNix users,
We’re more than happy to announce the Big Patch! The Big Patch update is planned at 18th June, 23:00~02:00 Pacific time. 
Since CroNix’s launch in February as Early Access, there has been many feedbacks and suggestions from users. The dev team began creating a new version of CroNix from March to satisfy users’ needs. After 3 months, the Big Patch is ready!

Changes and New Contents are as follows;
[*]A new mode called Raid has been implemented. Existing modes(Survival, Brawl, Domination) are removed from Regular match. Raid requires strategies, tactics and teamwork more than any other modes. 
[*]Another mode, Elimination, has been implemented. Elimination is a PVE mode where a team of players fight against a team of bots. Scores and results are not recorded.
[*]UI has been changed dramatically for better user experience.
[*]Matching system has gone under a great change for faster and easier matching. Intruder system has been implemented. 
[*]Combat system has been changed.
 - There’s no more Combat / Non-combat mode. 
 - Recovery Action is implemented. This particular action will restore AP quickly.
 - Sprint can be activated at anytime. However, it consume AP.
 - Some skills has been altered for balancing reasons.
[*]Manner Points. You’ll lose manner points if you leave a match. Depending on the amount of remaining Manner points, you may be prohibited from using some contents.

However, there are some contents that are cut from the new version;
[*]Previous modes(Survival, Brawl, Domination) are removed from Regular match. They will return in Custom match later.
[*]Single AI mode is removed, since PVE mode has been implemented.
[*]Skill Cards are removed from the game. It will be implemented again after some changes.
[*]Avatar items are removed temporarily.
[*]Two characters, Gear Rabbit and Kiriha, are removed temporarily. They’ll return after balancing fix.

PLEASE NOTE; With release of the Big patch, user data will be reset on 19th June. If you have purchased any DLC or Hard Currency, you’ll be awarded with items that are worthy of equal(or more) value. We’re terribly sorry for this, and we’ll do our best to bring you better action experience. 
All DLCs will be removed from store.

Compensation rewards are as follows;
[*]Bronze Pack DLC : 1300 Cash, 20 Kits, 7-day Bundle Booster
[*]Silver Pack DLC : 2600 Cash, 20 Premium Kits, 20 Kits, 7-day Bundle Booster, Silver-class limited Emblem and Title
[*]Gold Pack DLC : 3900 Cash, 30 Premium Kits, 30 Kits, 7-day Bundle Booster, Gold-class limited Emblem and Title
[*]Cash : For Cash buyers, we’ll give you as much Cash as you purchased.

Free 5 Kits will be given to anyone who plays CroNix from 20th June to 26th June!

Thank you!

notes.title: The BIG Patch is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Dear CroNix players,

The BIG patch is arriving in June! Since launching as Early Access in 12.2.15, there had been many feedbacks from players around the world, and the dev team has been developing the BIG patch since 5th March. At the moment the BIG patch is nearly complete!  

The followings are changes in BIG patch;

[*]A new mode, called “RAID”, has been implemented. Other modes(Brawl, Survival, Domination) are only playable through Custom Match. RAID mode will require more strategy and teamwork, rather than just actions.
[*]UI has been changed for easier navigation.
[*]Matching system has been upgraded. Players can communicate while waiting. Moreover, when someone leaves a match, another player can join in.
[*]Combat system is adjusted. There is no more Combat/non-combat system, and you can sprint at any time. However, sprinting will now consume AP. 
[*]A new system called Recovery is implemented. Using Recovery Action will replenish AP very quickly, allowing players to quickly re-engage combat.
[*]Knockdown time has been decreased. 
[*]As a result, combat is much quicker and swift, and players will have more control over their characters.
[*]Some skills are adjusted for balance.
[*]Challenges are implemented.
[*]Custom key bindings.


I’ll keep you posted when the BIG patch date is confirmed!
